name: Parry Probe (research)
description: Research for Texas the Omertosa's parry: press right-click just before a hit lands (any weapon; 0.3 s window). Every hit on you is logged with how long after your last right-click press it came; a press within the window cancels the hit, teleports you behind the attacker and strikes it, with a slash of harmless laser bolts whose look changes after each slash (Quasar short-lived, Quasar, Talon). F10 / F11 still cycle the window and look. Host or solo. Turn off when done.
